derivation_statement: Original CopperMCP two-pad routing fixture, extended with explicit KiCad reference and value properties so KiCad can export the board to Specctra DSN. It contains one intentionally unrouted AUDIO net and no third-party design content.

dsn_source_export.statement: A KiCad UI export produced this DSN from the public fixture; its transient export path was redacted before commit. The harness does not regenerate or compare DSN output and must not infer a causal relationship from separate content hashes.
